remarks: Discover the perfect location to build your dream home, located in the Town of Ellicottville and just 2 miles from the charming village of Ellicottville, Holiday Valley, and HoliMont ski resorts. This spacious lot offers a level entry point with a gentle slope that rises along a wooded ridge, creating the potential for beautiful hillside views with strategic building placement. A survey of the subdivision showing the approved building window is available. The lots are subject to town zoning law only, with no HOA or deed restrictions. Lot #1 (approx 10 acres) will offer views of the slopes and surrounding hills, and is gently sloping. Lots #6 and 7 (approx 6+ acres each) are more wooded, but command the same views of the surrounding hills. All the lots range in size from 6 to 10+ acres, giving you even more options to expand your vision of your dream home. Bring your creativity and imagine your ideal getaway or year-round retreat. This is your chance to claim a piece of Ellicottville’s sought-after four-season lifestyle. Opportunity is knocking—don’t miss out! Taxes shown are for the entire acreage and will be determined once the subdivision of the lot sale is complete. Surveys are completed for all lots and frontage is staked. The Buyer to accept the existing survey.
